# TrackFellow

> TrackFellow is the mobile field book for mantrailing and dog-tracking teams.

TrackFellow helps handlers lay and follow tracks with GPS, mark articles and other points along a track, record session feedback and notes, review training statistics, generate reports, and share tracks with other handlers. It is designed for beginners, experienced trackers, mantrailing teams, competitive dog-tracking teams, instructors, and recreational dog owners.

Company: Trackfellow AB (Swedish organization number 559473-2785)

## Terminology

- Mantrailing: scent work in which a dog follows the individual scent trail of a person.
- Dog tracking: training a dog to follow a specific scent trail to an article or destination.
- Article: an object placed on or associated with a track that the dog is expected to indicate or find.
